newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline barges softer, cargoes still firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline barges softer, cargoes still firm.

text.p: NWE gasoline barge prices eased on Wednesday, but cargoes were still firm with uncovered requirements seen into France, the U.K. and Poland.
Bids for premium unleaded cargoes were heard around $230 a tonne cif NWE, but prompt avails were scarce.
Traders said that Polish demand for 95 octane material had been partly covered after a small cargo traded at cif quotes +$3.

A eurograde barge traded early at $224 fob ARA, equivalent to Tuesday's last trade, but sellers' attempts to nudge up prices met with a poor response and later trades were seen at $223 and $222.50.--Rosalind Russell, London +44 171 542 5387
